day_local: Iiddii Dadka Quduuska ah oo Dhan
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaah, iyo wadaagga Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiyow, kani waa dadka raba inay wajigaaga arkaan.
homily:
Bal ka fikir sawirka beerta weyn ee ubaxu ka buuxo, halkaas oo midab kasta, qaab kasta, iyo caraf kasta ay isugu yimaadaan si ay u ammaanaan abuuraha. Maanta, kaniisaddu waxay ina tusaysaa sawir ka sii qurux badan: waa dad aan la tirin karin, oo ka kala yimid qowmiyad kasta, luuqad kasta, iyo qarni kasta, kuwaas oo isugu yimid carshiga Ilaah hortiisa. Waxay xiran yihiin dhar cad, gacmahana ku hayaan laamo timireed. Waa maalintii aan xusuusanayno in noloshu aysan ku dhammaanayn xuduudaha dunidan, balse ay tahay safar loo socdo dabbaaldegga weyn ee jannada.

Benjamin Vo, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu hadda ka mid yahay dadkaas tirada badan. Waxaan ognahay in Ben uu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda, koodhka, iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines', shirkaddaas yar ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin maanta, xusuusta Ben waxay inoo xiran tahay sawirka 'dhar cad' ee akhriska koowaad. Bawlos wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in kuwaas ay yihiin kuwii soo maray dhibaatadii weynayd, oo dharhoodii ku maydhay dhiigga Wanka. Ben, oo ahaa wiil jecel inuu dunida arko, oo la socday waalidkiis meel kasta oo ay tagaan, wuxuu hadda arkay meesha ugu quruxda badan: wuxuu arkay wajiga Ilaah.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa 'Barakaysan kuwa naxariista leh, waayo iyaga ayaa naxariis loo tusi doonaa.' Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil naxariis badan. Xusuusnow markii uu dhowr sano ka hor, isagoo da' yar, uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa sanduuqa ku jirta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa calaamad muujinaysa jacayl aan xad lahayn. Taasi waa jacaylka uu maanta ku dhex leeyahay jannada. Jacaylkaas ayaa ah kan maanta idin daryeelaya, isagoo idin xusuusinaya in Ben uusan idin iloobin.

Ben wuxuu hadda la joogaa dadka quduuska ah. Wuxuu la joogaa kuwa dhibaatada soo maray ee hadda nabad helay. Wuxuu la joogaa Saint Carlo Acutis, oo isaguna ahaa wiil dhalinyaro ah oo nolosha u arkaayay indho jacayl leh. Waxay labadooduba hadda u duceeyaan qoysaskooda, waxay u duceeyaan dhakhaatiirta, waxay u duceeyaan carruurta kale ee la ildaran xanuunka, si aan qoys kale u marin jidkan xanuunka badan. Ben waa 'con chim'—shimbirtaas yare ee hadda si xor ah ugu duulaysa hawada jannada, isagoon lahayn wax culeys ah ama xanuun ah.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida gacantii uu Ben u fidiyay qoyskiisa, jacaylka uu kuu hayo wuxuu sii wadi doonaa inuu ku dhex koro nolol maalmeedkaaga, isagoo ku siinaya xoog iyo rajo.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho, maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si muuqata. Igu dhex noolow, oo ha ii oggolaan inaan weligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin ilaaliyo. Nabadda Rabbiga ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhoweeyo iftiinka wejigiisa, halkaas oo aysan jirin xanuun iyo murugo.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culeyska wada, inuu Rabbigu u soo dejiyo rajo, nabad, iyo xoog ay nolosha ugu sii wadaan jacaylka Ben.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Anigoo Yooxanaa ah, waxaan arkay malaa'ig kale oo ka soo kacaysa xagga bari, oo haysata shaabaddii Ilaaha nool. Waxayna cod weyn ugu qaylisay afartii malaa'igood oo la siiyey awood ay ku waxyeeleeyaan dhulka iyo badda, iyadoo leh, 'Ha waxyeeleynina dhulka ama badda ama geedaha ilaa aan shaabadda saarno foolasha addoommada Ilaaheenna.' Waxaan maqlay tirada kuwii la shaabadeeyey, boqol iyo afar iyo afartan kun oo laga shaabadeeyey qabiil kasta oo reer binu Israa'iil ah. Intaas ka dib, waxaan arkay dad badan oo aan qofna tirin karin, oo ka kala yimid qowmiyad, jinsi, dad, iyo af kasta. Waxay hor taagnaayeen carshiga iyo Wanka hortiisa, iyagoo xiran dhar cad, gacmahana ku haya laamo timireed. Waxayna cod weyn ugu qayliyeen, 'Badbaadintu waxay ka timaadaa Ilaaheenna carshiga ku fadhiya, iyo Wanka.' Malaa'igtii oo dhami waxay taagnaayeen carshiga iyo odayaasha iyo afarta makhluuq ee nool hareerahooda. Waxayna sujuudeen carshiga hortiisa, iyagoo caabudaya Ilaah, oo leh, 'Aamiin. Barako iyo ammaan, xigmad iyo mahadnaq, sharaf, awood, iyo xoog ha u ahaadeen Ilaaheenna weligiis iyo weligiisba. Aamiin.' Markaas mid ka mid ah odayaashii ayaa i weydiiyey, 'Kuwani waa ayo kuwa xiran dharka cad, xagse ayay ka yimaadeen?' Waxaan ku idhi, 'Sayidow, adigaa og.' Wuxuuna igu yidhi, 'Kuwani waa kuwii ka soo badbaaday wakhtigii dhibaatada weyn; waxay dharhoodii ku maydheen, oo ku caddeeyeen dhiigga Wanka.'

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbiyow, kani waa dadka raba inay wajigaaga arkaan. Rabbigaa iska leh dhulka iyo waxa ka buuxa; dunida iyo kuwa ku dhex noolba. Waayo isagaa ku dhisay badaha, oo ku aasaasay webiyada. Rabbiyow, kani waa dadka raba inay wajigaaga arkaan. Yaa fuuli kara buurta Rabbiga? Yaa taagnaan kara meeshiisa quduuska ah? Kii gacmihiisu nadiif yihiin, qalbigiisuna saafi yahay, kii aan wax aan micno lahayn rabin. Rabbiyow, kani waa dadka raba inay wajigaaga arkaan. Isagu wuxuu ka heli doonaa barako Rabbiga, iyo abaalmarin Ilaaha badbaadiyaha ah. Waa kan dadka isaga raadiya, ee raadiya wajiga Ilaaha Yacquub. Rabbiyow, kani waa dadka raba inay wajigaaga arkaan.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Gacaliye: Bal eeg jacaylka Aabbuhu inoo siiyey in naloo bixiyo carruurta Ilaah. Sidaas ayaannuna nahay. Dunidu ma na taqaan sababtoo ah iyadu isaga ma ay aqoon. Gacaliye, hadda waxaan nahay carruurta Ilaah; waxa aynu noqon doonno weli lama muujin. Waxaan ognahay in markii la muujiyo aynu isaga u ekaan doonno, waayo waxaan arki doonnaa isaga sida uu yahay. Qof kasta oo rajadan ku qaba isaga, wuu is-nadiifiyaa, sida isagu u nadiif yahay.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Markii Ciise arkay dadkii badnaa, wuxuu fuulay buurta, markuu fadhiistayna, xertiisu u yimaadeen. Wuxuuna bilaabay inuu baro, isagoo leh, 'Barakaysan kuwa xaqiiqda ku saboolka ah, waayo iyagaa leh Boqortooyada jannada. Barakaysan kuwa baroorta, waayo iyagaa la qaboojin doonaa. Barakaysan kuwa qabowga leh, waayo iyagaa dhulka dhaxli doona. Barakaysan kuwa gaajaysan oo u harraadan xaqnimada, waayo iyagaa dhergi doona. Barakaysan kuwa naxariista leh, waayo iyagaa naxariis loo tusi doonaa. Barakaysan kuwa qalbiga saafida ah, waayo iyagaa arki doona Ilaah. Barakaysan kuwa nabadda abuura, waayo iyagaa loo bixin doonaa carruurta Ilaah. Barakaysan kuwa loo silciyey xaqnimada dartiis, waayo iyagaa leh Boqortooyada jannada. Barakaysan tihiin markay idin caayaan oo idin silciyaan oo ay idinku sheegaan wax kasta oo shar ah si been ah aniga dartay. Farxa oo rayreeya, waayo abaalmarintiinnu jannada way weynaan doontaa.'

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
